name: LTX 2.5 Distilled ComfyUI Video One-Click
readme:
# LTX 2.5 Distilled ComfyUI Video One-Click

One-click LTX-2.5 Distilled video and audio generation in ComfyUI. A100 80 GB is recommended. The template uses a 100 GB container disk and zero persistent volume.

Create the RunPod secret `HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN` and accept the gated LTX-2.5 model terms before launching. The template injects it through `{{ RUNPOD_SECRET_HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN }}`. Models, cache, logs, and outputs live on temporary container storage unless outputs are backed up externally.

RunPod environment fields are listed alphabetically. S3 settings default to DigitalOcean Spaces in SFO3. Create secrets named `S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, fill in `S3_BUCKET`, and set `REALTIME_BACKUP=true` to enable output backup.

HTTP ports: 8188, 8888, 8675. TCP ports: 22, 8080. UDP ports: 22, 8080. The image has no registry credentials or start-command override.
